login.title: Log in
login.forgot_text: Ask your church admin to send you a reset link.

setup.title: Set up Liturgist
setup.intro: Create your church and the first church admin. You can change the church settings later.
setup.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A few words together are easy to remember.
setup.incomplete: This link is incomplete. Open the setup link printed in the server log.

membership.not_member: You are no longer a member of this church.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.what: Names, email addresses and phone numbers of the people your church invites, and the liturgies you prepare together.
privacy.ip: IP addresses are kept only briefly, to block people guessing passwords, and are deleted within an hour.
privacy.why: To let your church team prepare and publish liturgies together.
privacy.who: Members who are allowed to see the member list can see contact details. The server's administrator can see everything stored on the server.

weak_password.matches_identity: The password must not be your name, email, phone number or church name.
